title: Define and implement dynamic reference-pool policy

controls: nondecreasing initial, uncertainty-expansion and selective-rescore member limits
global and local per-candidate minima and maxima
canonical exact-local through global geographic fallback order
observer, locality, burst, country and independent-observation diversity
bounded margin-triggered expansion increment, rank limit and round count
mandatory target and complete safety-union retention
prohibited family and geography hard pruning
deterministic UInt64 seed and complete policy fingerprint

semantics: select biological reference observations rather than arbitrary media volume
prefer committed global anchors and exact workload-cluster local references
reuse cached embedding fingerprints without copying embedding vectors
deduplicate observations, duplicate groups and supplied burst groups across a plan
round-robin candidate taxa under stage and total budgets
cap observer and locality reuse and preserve one validated route/domain
record unmaterialized distance as unavailable rather than fabricating a value
emit the Phase 0 immutable plan, member and summary contracts

coverage_reporting.grain: one dynamic pool plan and source candidate taxon
properties: global, local, safety and independent-observation shortfalls remain separate
local-unavailable and fallback reasons remain exact
no-geo is evidence unavailability and never taxon absence
coverage reporting never authorizes production release

fixture_round_trip.evidence_class: deterministic implementation fixture; not live reference-pool evidence
counterexamples: a five-member shared stage budget produced balanced class counts of three and two
one repeated observer and locality was capped to one member under the strict fixture policy
two observations in one supplied burst group filled only one slot
pinned-specimen route/domain evidence did not enter an adult-field plan
a candidate with no references remained in coverage as no_reference_support
a no-geo request remained global-only with no_geo_global_fallback
